title: Dictionaries in Python
description: Learn how dictionaries in Python work: create and modify key-value pairs using dict literals, the dict() constructor, built-in methods, and operators.
summary: Python dictionaries are a powerful built-in data type that allows you to store key-value pairs for efficient data retrieval and manipulation. Learning about them is essential for developers who want to process data efficiently.
takeaways: By the end of this tutorial, you’ll understand that: A dictionary in Python is a mutable collection of key-value pairs that allows for efficient data retrieval using unique keys.
By learning about Python dictionaries, you’ll be able to access values through key lookups and modify dictionary content using various methods .
